notes.title: Chapter 7 Release and Chapter 1 Voice Acting
notes.notes:
Chapter 7 and voice acting for chapter 1 have been simultaneously released!

In case you missed the last post, Chapter 7 is the most climatic chapter so far with the biggest and most impactful twists yet that will recontextualize much of what has been seen previously in Friendly Facade. The chapter explores the consequences that befall the participants of the Isolated Society Study after the tragic murder of one of them at the hands of another. Having only just barely beginning to recover from the previous death, Maggie is again thrust into a position where she has to struggle through a seemingly hopeless situation. Through our play testing, we estimate the length of day 7 to be about 4-5 hours and if you've stuck with us on this journey this far, you will get a lot out of experiencing this chapter. Much of the chapter revolves around information and relationships that were developed in previous chapters.

We hope that voice acting for chapter 1 will elevate the experience and make the game more accessible and enjoyable for newcomers as well as those who want to revisit where the story began. We plan to continue supporting voice acting for the rest of the chapters in the future.

Additionally, when implementing voice acting into the game, I reworked much of the game's audio systems. Now you can alter the master volume as well as the volume of music, sound effects, and voice acting independently of each other while playing the game. Please feel free to report any bugs you find in the game, audio or otherwise, so that we can address those issues quickly.

As always, to access the new content, either load a save from the end of day 6 or use the chapter select menu and click on day 7.

We hope you look forward to playing this new chapter and continue to support the game. Thank you so much.

-Robbie

notes.title: Chapter 4 & 5 Release!
notes.notes:
Hello Friendly Facade community. It's finally time for chapters 4 and 5 of Friendly Facade to be released! Unlike our previous content updates, this release features two days, both day 4 and day 5, instead of just one!

Be sure to watch the trailer here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jsYyo_Wa8Cw

This is the largest and most transformative content update yet, so we are very excited to see everyone's reactions to it. Through our play testing, we estimate the length of days 4 and 5 to be about 5-6 hours. The minigame for day 4 is split into four smaller activities, each with a different gimmick that needs to be played around. Days 4 and 5 play off of each other immensely, which is the reason we are releasing them at the same time. Together, they form the most climactic part of the entire game thus far, packed with plenty of reveals, and offers resolution to many of the mysteries and conflicts inside of the Isolated Society Study. With the experiment nearing it's final stage, many of the participants will be looking to become the winner of the Isolated Society Study and claim the unknown prize for themselves.

We hope you enjoy playing this new chapter and continue to support the game. Thank you so much.

-Robbie

notes.title: Chapter 3 has been released!
notes.notes:
Chapter 3 is here!

Chapter 3 offers a few more hours of content packed with rich character moments and the intriguing continuation of the Friendly Facade Story. This is the most character-driven chapter yet and offers a minigame that has a unique change of pace compared to the previous 2. Check the previous post for more details: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2256920/view/3665422306549625285

In addition to the details I mentioned previously, I'd also like to note that the artwork for all of the sprites have been touched up and improved with better shading and texture. An example of this can be seen below. Additionally, this is a reminder that the text log can be toggled on and off during dialogue using the 'L' key going forward (this is now explained in chapter 1, but if you're picking back up the game with chapter 3, you will have missed this tutorial).

To play chapter 3, you can either load an existing save of day 2 at night and speed through the tail end of the day 2 dialogue to continue your past save file, or start with the chapter select menu to skip right to day 3.

Thank you for playing! I hope you enjoy this update! If you have any issues please let us know.

notes.title: Chapter 3 Trailer, Details, and Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello once again Friendly Facade community. We are very excited to announce that chapter 3 of Friendly Facade will be releasing on September 29th!

You can check out the trailer for chapter 3 here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jj3vjgLIkvA

This chapter will include another large expansion to the story on the same level as chapters 1 and 2. Through our play testing, we estimate the length of chapter 3 to be about 2-3 hours. There will also be another new minigame that is split into two phases. The first phase will require thoughtful decision making that will influence the second phase. The second phase will be the most hands-on minigame in the game. Chapter 3 will also be the most character-driven chapter so far. We are excited for you to experience the backstories and developments of the characters in this chapter as the conflict boiling just beneath the surface in the Isolated Society finally begins to come to a head.

Along with chapter 3, as always we have tried to improve the overall quality of the game. There have been minor text changes and bugs fixes in the previous chapters (but nothing that affects the story, obviously). I have also optimized the memory management somewhat and added more quality of life features. One major feature I've added is the text log, which will allow you to read previous dialogue lines during scenes. This can be accessed by pressing 'L' when the dialogue box is open in the new update. We are also improving and cleaning up some of the art in chapter 1 with this new update. For example, Holly's design has been changed to better fit her character. A visual of what this looks like can be seen below.

Thank you so much for supporting the game.

-Robbie

notes.title: Chapter 2 Release!
notes.notes:
Chapter 2 is here!

Chapter 2 almost doubles the game in length and offers more content and a more complex and involved minigame than what was in chapter 1. There are also new character moments and mysteries to discover!
Check the previous post for more details: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2256920/view/3665413967456094961

If you have already played chapter 1, use the chapter select menu to skip straight to day 2. (Save files from the previous build of the game won't work on this update due to the reworked save system.)

Chapter 1 has also been released in it's entirety as the demo for Friendly Facade.

Thank you for playing! I hope you enjoy this update! If you have any issues please let us know.

notes.title: Chapter 2 Trailer, Details, and Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello Friendly Facade community. We are very excited to release chapter 2 of the game, coming June 23rd.

Check out the trailer for chapter 2 here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eIIpjAOb3rw&ab_channel=FriendlyFacade

This chapter will include a large expansion to the story, almost doubling it in size. Through our play testing, we estimate the length of chapter 2 to be about 2-4 hours. It also includes a brand new mini-game which is far more in-depth than anything seen in chapter 1. I hope you'll find the character developments and reveals in chapter 2 as intriguing as we do, as the mystery of the Isolated Society Study becomes even more complex and the underlying distrust and conflict grows more apparent.

With the release of chapter 2, we will be raising the price of the game slightly. For those that already have Friendly Facade in their steam library, you will be able to continue to enjoy all the content updates that are added to the game for free, since you already own the game. We appreciate you all for supporting the game this early on. Chapter 1 will continue to be free to play through the Friendly Facade demo which will be releasing at the same time as chapter 2.

There are also many overall improvements to the game coming with the chapter 2 update, such as bug fixes and minor text changes to chapter 1. Most notably the save system of the game is being overhauled. I have completely changed the way saving works in the code, made the game auto save much more frequently, and added multiple save slots that you can manually save your data to. Because of these changes, if you played chapter 1, your save file may not work anymore. Nevertheless, you will be able to use the new chapter select menu to start the game right from chapter 2, skipping over chapter 1. Use this if you've already played chapter 1 to skip right to the new content. These changes will improve the quality of the game going forward, and we plan on implementing more quality of life updates of a similar nature as production of the game continues.

Thank you so much for supporting the game.

-Robbie

Also, feel free to join our discord server to stay up to date with the game, updates, and community!
